articles.title: J.J. McCarthy channels rival Dak Prescott with hilarious pregame workout.
articles.summary: Quarterback J. J. McCarthy went viral without even throwing a ball for the New York Giants, as he emulated rival Dak Prescott’s hilarious pregame workout that involved an unusual hip and core activation routine on the field. McCarthy, who was traded to the Giants from the Minnesota Vikings, performed repeated fake-throw motions that caught the attention of fans and cameras, turning a warm-up drill into a trending moment. Fans are expecting that the focused sequence will set the tone for the confidence he carried into the season. J. J. was selected 10th overall in the first round of the 2024 NFL Draft by Minnesota, but the lack of consistent playing time and some injuries had him out of the franchise for good in less than two years.

articles.title: Nikola Jokic and Nuggets teammates head to Boulder for the Deion Sanders experience.
articles.summary: Nikola Jokic is usually not the NBA superstar looking for the spotlight. On Saturday night, he was perfectly happy to take it in. The Denver Nuggets' three-time MVP brought several teammates to Folsom Field to watch Deion Sanders and Colorado take on No. 12 Texas Tech, turning a college football game into an early-season team-bonding opportunity. Jokic's presence was notable for another reason: his relationship with Sanders has come a long way. Not long ago, Jokic acknowledged that he didn't even know who "Prime Time" was. Now, the Nuggets center was sitting in the stands watching Sanders coach Colorado alongside members of his own team.

Los visitantes permanecieron durante un largo periodo en los vestuarios y se han negado inicialmente a saltar al terreno de juego, hasta la llegada de efectivos de la Guardia Civil y la Policía Nacional.
